title: A butterfly
why: Look at the four wings and the long body: this is the adult stage that lays eggs to start the cycle again.
credit: “Animated Flying Fluttering Butterfly Loop” by LasquetiSpice, CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab

title: A grown-up frog
why: Look at the strong back legs and the sticky toes: the tadpole's tail is gone and the frog now breathes with lungs.
credit: “CC0 モリアオガエル 🐸 ♂ Forest Green Tree Frog” by ffish.asia / floraZia.com, CC0, via Sketchfab
